summary: Two large avatars whose fallback is a custom icon: one with an image that fails to decode and one with no image.
use: Representing groups or bots, where initials do not make sense, with a lucide icon.
spec: `<Avatar src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="Family" size="lg" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">` uses an image that fails to decode
`{#snippet fallback()}<Users size={22} aria-hidden="true" />{/snippet}` renders the Users icon
`{#snippet fallback()}<Bot size={22} aria-hidden="true" />{/snippet}` renders the Bot icon
